notes.title: Our friends are developing a cool coop horror game. Add to wishlist
notes.content:
INOUT is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. For years, the locals have been afraid of an old mansion in Madyland. A possessed maniac and an ancient evil have settled here. Become a member of a team of exorcists and expel the evil force! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2072640/Inout/

notes.title: Check this out
notes.content:
http://store.steampowered.com/app/654470/Blood_Waves/

Hardcore and bloody shooter where you will have to repulse the attacks of the living dead using the destroying traps, defensive barricades and also weapon of close and long-range combat.
